newsitem.title: UK: Unilever up after press reports on sale.
newsitem.headline: Unilever up after press reports on sale.

text.p: Shares in Anglo-Dutch consumer products group Unilever moved ahead to test the 1600 pence level in early trading after favourable press reports, dealers said.
At 1000 GMT Unilever was quoted at 1587p bid, for a net 12p gain, after setting a 1601p high earlier, its best level since March 26.
Newspaper reports dealt with likely bidders for Unilever's specialty chemicals business after the deadline for indicative offers closed last week.
Unilever's specialty chemicals business was put up for sale in February. The Financial Times newspaper said Akzo Nobel and Dupont may be bidders alongside ICI and others.
"The gains were on the back of the weekend press," a marketmaker in the stock said.
The move to 1601p nearly filled a gap reaching up to 1603p which opened over the Easter break.
The Mail on Sunday newspaper said ICI was poised to make a four billion stg bid for the specialty chemicals division.
Unilever had no comment on the press reports.
